answers.reason: Marker 1 is located in the high-temperature completely liquid phase region (L), which is not listed among the available choices.
Marker 2 is situated in the single-phase solid solution field below the solidus line and above the low-temperature miscibility gap.
Marker 3 lies inside the two-phase lens between the liquidus and solidus curves, representing equilibrium between the liquid and solid solution.
Marker 4 is inside the low-temperature miscibility gap where the solid solution separates into two isostructural fcc phases of different compositions.
